t: This is Archway station on the High Barnet branch of the Northern line, between Highgate and Tufnell Park. It lies directly underneath the Vantage Point building, where Holloway Road, Highgate Hill, Junction Road and Archway Road meet. It is in fare zones 2 and 3. The station was designed by Leslie Green, an English architect best known for his Underground stations of the early twentieth century. His style is recognised by oxblood red faience blocks, pillars, semicircular first-floor windows and patterned tiled interiors in the Modern Style.
